index.seoTitle: Lapland nature news: research from the fells
index.description: News about the nature of Finnish Lapland: research, protected areas and the rules on the trails. Every story names and links its sources.
index.lead: News about the nature of Finnish Lapland: new research, protected areas and the rules on the trails. Every story is written from the original sources, and every source is named and linked.
index.aboutText: We open every source before writing and report only what it says. Where a press release and the research paper differ, we say which one a number comes from, and we link both.
index.heroAlt: The Teno river and autumn-coloured slopes near Kuoppilasjoki in Utsjoki
